    return MODES[mode][action]"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"pm_1.py","headingEn":"main(): experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() prints the table, replays the session under each mode, counts unattended risky actions and applies deny rules.","descKn":"main() ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಮುದ್ರಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆಷನ್ ಮರುಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸಿ, ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಎಣಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು deny ನಿಯಮ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

    print("each mode answers the same six questions differently, from asking about everything to allowing everything, and plan mode allows reads and denies the rest; the table is a simplified model with invented cells")

    section("2. Genuinely measuring: the same forty-action session under each mode")

        print(f"{m:12} allow {c['allow']:2d} | ask {c['ask']:2d} | deny {c['deny']:2d}")

def obfuscate(cmd, r):
    kind = r.choice(["split", "b64", "case"])
    if kind == "split":
        return cmd.replace("rm", "r''m").replace("curl", "cu''rl").replace("DROP", "DR''OP").replace("chmod", "ch''mod")
    if kind == "b64":
        return "echo " + base64.b64encode(cmd.encode()).decode() + " | base64 -d | sh"
    return cmd.upper() if cmd != cmd.upper() else cmd


KEYWORDS = ["rm ", "curl", "chmod", "--force", "dd ", "drop table", "ssh", "| sh", "base64"]


def stage1(cmd):
    """Cheap filter: flags anything containing a keyword; deliberately broad."""
    c = cmd.lower()
    return any(k in c for k in KEYWORDS)


def stage2(cmd):
    """Stricter check run only on flagged commands: looks for the specific dangerous patterns."""
    c = cmd.lower()
    patterns = ["rm -rf", "| sh", "chmod -r", "--force", "dd if=", "drop table", "id_rsa", "base64 -d"]
    return any(p in c for p in patterns)


def make_set(r, n=400):
    data = []

            if r.random() < 0.4:
                cmd = obfuscate(cmd, r)
            data.append((cmd, True))
        else:
            data.append((r.choice(BENIGN), False))
    return data

    fn = sum(1 for (c, y), p in zip(data, pred) if y and not p)

    rec = tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else 0.0
